author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring freelance artists for character design, illustration, backgrounds
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang. Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam: Character Design & Illustration, Character Sprites, Background & Environment Art, Webtoon / Comic Artwork, Game & Digital Art Assets. Cara Melamar: kirimkan portofolio dan perkenalan singkat ke avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com Subject: Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]. Include art style, availability, rate freelance.
